catalogSubtitle: Interactive 3D physics — change the variables and watch the numbers respond.
webglRequired: 3D view requires a WebGL-capable browser. Controls and readouts still work.

projectile.desc: Launch a projectile and watch range, height and flight time.

double-pendulum.desc: A chaotic system — a tiny change in the start angle changes everything.

incline-friction.desc: Slide a block down a ramp and see how friction changes its acceleration.

ohm-circuit.desc: Vary voltage and series resistance; watch current and power (V = I·R).

waves.desc: Change the amplitude, frequency and wavelength of a traveling wave (v = f·λ).

lens-optics.desc: Move the object near a convex lens and trace the image (1/f = 1/d + 1/d′).
